verdict.rationale: Obsidian's general plugin API (obsidian-docs-7, -31, -33) allows third-party integrations, and community evidence confirms AI-oriented community plugins exist (e.g., 'Copilot for local AI via Ollama', 'Whisper for local dictation' in obsidian-comm-12), but there is no first-party AI connector or official AI integration documented, and one commenter notes skepticism about local RAG tooling (obsidian-comm-8). missing for 10: first-party LLM/AI connector docs, dedicated AI plugin directory or official endorsement, broader corroboration beyond a single community list.
